state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 4.** `nvs-config` reads `[ldap.<name>]` and `[capabilities.ldap]`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` opens connections (`connect`, `open`) and runs `who_am_i`, `search` and `read`. `Core\Ldap::connect`/`open` are registered with six server-free cases. `nvs_ldap::Filter::Encoded` (a pre-encoded filter, written out as it is) and `nvs_ldap::is_attribute_description` (RFC 4512's name check) are on `main`.

**The members are written and wait on branch `ldap-stage4-members`** (one commit on top of `cd9b49179`, stdlib files only). It registers `Ldap\Connection::whoami`/`search`/`read`, `Ldap\Entries` (its own iterator, in `DISPATCH_ROSTER`, `ITERABLES` and `HOST_HANDLE_CLASSES`), `Ldap\Entry` (`dn`, `has`, `string`, `strings`, `bytes`), `Ldap\Filter` (`equals`, `present`, one `ber` slot) and `Ldap\Scope` (`Base`, `OneLevel`, `Subtree`). A search parks its cursor on `Held` under an id (`Entries::park`, `step`). The bodies are in the new `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs`. A probe against `samba-ad` printed the right `whoami`, DN, `string`, `strings`, `bytes`, a paged `OneLevel` walk, `read` returning `null` for a missing DN, and the attribute-name `LogicError`.

**Why it is not on `main`:** `conformance_coverage.rs` needs three `.nvst` cases per new member (10 members), plus a case or an "unreachable from source" comment for every `Fault` site in `search.rs`. Most cases need `samba-ad`, and no `.nvst` can name its CA yet. `tests/db/ca.crt` is git-ignored and differs per volume, `tls_ca_file` resolves against the case's own `nvs.toml`, and the TLS roots are `webpki_roots` alone.

`dn()` returns `string` until `Dn` exists (Stage 5). `toArray` and `Entries::references` are not written. `Ldap\Settings` still lacks `base` and `tlsCaFile`.

items.text: **A `.nvst` case can copy a repository file next to itself**: a `--COPY--` section, one path per line relative to the case file, copied into the working directory before `--SKIPIF--`. A missing source skips the case and names the file. Model it on `--EXTENSION--` (`crates/nvs-test/src/case.rs:360` parses it, `crates/nvs-test/src/run.rs:366` writes it), and add its row to the section table in `crates/nvs-test/src/lib.rs:28`. A case then writes `../../db/ca.crt` and `tls_ca_file = "ca.crt"`. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`.

**Land branch `ldap-stage4-members`** with `git cherry-pick ldap-stage4-members`, then delete the branch with `git branch -d`. Write the cases: three per member of `Ldap\Connection`, `Ldap\Entry` and `Ldap\Filter`, the acceptance case `tests/conformance/core/ldap-connect-and-search.nvst`, and an assertion or an "unreachable from source" comment for each `Fault` site in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:68`. Server-free cases: a tainted DN or `base` does not compile, a tainted `select` name does not compile, `Filter::equals` accepts a tainted value, a bad attribute name throws `LogicError`. ADR 0278 § 1, § 5 and § 6.
**`Entry::toArray` and `Entries::references`** (ADR 0278 § 1 and § 5) in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:205`, each with three cases.
